item.title: Watch: Trump's 'YMCA' dance moves at US Navy's 250th anniversary event steal the show; crowd goes wild
item.description: During a government shutdown, President Trump celebrated the Navy's 250th anniversary in Norfolk, dancing to 'YMCA' and assuring service members of full pay. He criticized Democrats, proposed military training in US cities, and outlined plans to reshape Pentagon culture for domestic priorities and combat drug cartels.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Motel owner shot in the head in Pittsburg: 'Are you alright?' he asked the shooter
item.description: A 51-year-old motel owner, Rakesh Ehagaban, was fatally shot in Robinson by Stanley Eugene West after checking on a dispute. West had first shot his female companion in the motel parking lot, then shot Rakesh when he intervened. West later shot a police officer, with both victims hospitalized.

item.title: Newsom slams Trump for deploying California National Guard to Oregon
item.description: US President Donald Trump deployed 300 California National Guard members to Oregon, a move Governor Gavin Newsom condemned as a "breathtaking abuse of law." This action followed a federal judge blocking Trump's attempt to deploy Oregon's own Guard.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: No guarantee you will return: US rejects Indian student's visa plea, cites no strong tie to home country
item.description: Indian student Kaushik Raj received a US visa rejection, despite a $100,000 Columbia scholarship, due to officials' belief he lacked sufficient ties to India. The rejection letter said that an applicant has to demonstrate that they have a residence in a foreign country which they have no intention of abandoning.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 47,000 foreign students may now be in Canada illegally, says IRCC; 'India one of the top countries'
item.description: Canada's IRCC revealed nearly 47,000 foreign students are potentially in the country illegally, violating visa terms by not attending classes. ​Aiesha Zafar, the head of migration integrity at the agency, said that 47,175 people who entered Canada as students are potentially “non-compliant,” meaning that they are not attending classes as required by the terms of their visa.

item.title: Zayed charity run, UAE’s global fundraising race, to hold first event in Rio, Brazil
item.description: The Zayed Charity Run arrives in Rio de Janeiro on October 5, 2025, marking its first South American stop. This global event combines fitness, culture, and philanthropy, with proceeds directly supporting local Rio charities focused on vulnerable children, women, and families. Featuring 5km and 10km races, it promotes unity and humanitarian impact.

item.title: “I don’t consider him”: Stephen A. Smith speaks out on Shedeur Sanders mute media act amid Cleveland Browns QB drama
item.description: Shedeur Sanders made headlines in Cleveland on October 1, 2025. He remained silent during a press conference. Stephen A. Smith defended his actions, calling judgment unfair. Cam Newton discussed Sanders' brand value for the Browns. Both analysts agreed his true test would come only when he steps onto the field.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Civil unrest in Dem cities as libs accuse Donald Trump's 'gestapo' of running amuck
item.description: Urban America is gripped by civil unrest as the Trump administration escalates conflicts with Democrat-run cities. Chicago's ICE operations, dubbed "gestapo tactics," involved chemical irritants against protesters, while a federal judge blocked Trump's National Guard deployment in Portland, citing false "war-ravaged" claims. These events underscore deepening political rifts, with dissenters labeled "left-wing terrorists" and officials facing removal for defying the administration.
item.dc:creator: Chidanand Rajghatta

item.title: Mount Everest blizzard: Nearly 1,000 trapped on eastern slope at Tibetan side; rescue efforts under way
item.description: A severe blizzard has left nearly 1,000 stranded on Mount Everest's Tibetan side, with rescue efforts underway amid heavy snowfall. Concurrently, devastating rains in Nepal triggered landslides and flash floods, causing at least 47 deaths and leaving nine missing. Authorities in both regions are intensifying relief operations to reach affected communities and stranded visitors.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai Police bust drug network operating from residential villa, seize 40kg of narcotics
item.description: Dubai Police have dismantled a drug trafficking network operating from a residential villa, arresting two Asian nationals and seizing 40kg of narcotics including ketamine, crystal meth, marijuana, and hashish oil. The operation was directed by a gang leader abroad. Using advanced technology and intelligence, authorities continue targeting drug networks and urge the public to report suspicious activities via 901 or the Police Eye app.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Bahrain-Kuwait agreement to boost medical training and affordable health services for residents
item.description: Kuwait and Bahrain have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to significantly enhance healthcare development, medical training, and expertise exchange. This collaboration aims to provide residents with faster access to medical services, improved hospital infrastructure, and highly skilled medical staff. The partnership also strengthens regional health security and emergency preparedness for future health challenges.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai opens 300 metre bridge, cuts travel time to Mall of the Emirates to 1 minute
item.description: Dubai’s Roads and Transport Authority, partnering with Majid Al Futtaim Properties, has opened a new 300-metre bridge on Sheikh Zayed Road, cutting travel time from Abu Dhabi and Jebel Ali to Mall of the Emirates from 10 minutes to 1. The project includes major road, pedestrian, and cycling upgrades, supporting the mall’s Dh5 billion expansion and improving traffic flow and safety.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Keen to reach agreement': Hamas official signals readiness for Gaza talks with Israel in Egypt; aims to begin prisoner exchange 'immediately'
item.description: Hamas officials expressed eagerness for a peace agreement and prisoner exchange, as negotiators gather in Egypt to discuss details of a Trump-approved plan. Hamas demands Israel halt military operations and withdraw from Gaza City, offering to suspend its own actions. The plan includes Israel releasing over 1950 Palestinian prisoners.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Dubai opens doors for German businesses with easy setup and quick growth support
item.description: The Dubai Integrated Economic Zones Authority partnered with the German–Emirati Joint Council to attract German businesses, entrepreneurs, and startups to Dubai. This collaboration offers dedicated support, fast-track registration, and innovation platforms in sectors like Industry 4.0 and digital trade, aiming to boost bilateral economic ties and align with Dubai's D33 agenda.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Flydubai updates power bank rules from October 2025 following Emirates safety measures
item.description: Starting October 1, 2025, Flydubai will allow passengers to carry only one power bank with a capacity of 100Wh or less in hand baggage. Use of power banks onboard is banned, and they must be stored under the seat or in the seat pocket—not in overhead lockers or checked luggage. These rules align with Emirates’ safety measures to reduce lithium battery risks during flights.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
